147-2921-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-2150-4247.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-3908.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-3908.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Spark Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-3908.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1116-2438-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1116-2438-2946-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2724-3963-4006.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3963-4006.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Meneldor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7415.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Old-Growth Educator trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2178-2292-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

969-2085-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

231-1021-3390-4067.description:
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Drownyard Temple from the battlefield to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Drownyard Temple, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

38-301-4802.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-4802.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat.

586-2350-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1, creating a Blood token.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2506-6181.description:
Cast Nova Chaser by paying its mana cost.
When Nova Chaser enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Nova Chaser with haste.
When the Nova Chaser token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Nova Chaser until the token Nova Chaser leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Nova Chaser.
The token Nova Chaser leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Nova Chaser from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4772-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4050-4772-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting two +1/+1 counters on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3055-3175-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

803-3510-3678.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-3510-3678.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Arcane Adaptation, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Repeat step 3.

559-575-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Frontline Strategist, adding {W}.
When Frontline Strategist dies, Yedora triggers, returning Frontline Strategist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Frontline Strategist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Frontline Strategist's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

215-1770-4022.description:
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hidden Herbalists to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying {1}{G}.
When Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
